4. Plaintiffs have examined 5 witnesses in support of their claim and exhibited the khatian and the deed of endowment. On the other hand, the defendant has examined 6 witnesses and exhibited documentary evidence, as Exhibits. Ka-Da. 

 29. DW 1 admitted in course of cross-examination that the suit lands were wrongly recorded and that the record was prepared in his name. Exhibit-Ga shows that the suit lands have been recorded in the name of plaintiff Sree Sree Ma Kalimata Thakurani. The learned Advocate has drawn our attention to a khatian from the record which shows that after the suit lands have been recorded in the name of the deity, the appellant has got his name recorded as the exclusive owner in pursuance of the judgment passed in Miscellaneous Case No. 338 of 1968. DW 1 himself has admitted that he has recorded the suit lands in his own name by deleting the name of Sree Shashan Kalimata. The consistent case is that there was a Kali Mondir in the suit lands. DW 1 also admitted that Abinash Babu constructed a Mondir on the suit lands and established the image of the idol and thereafter performed seba puja therein. He further admitted that he also performed the seba puja there and that there is no existence of the Mondir. According to him, the plaintiffs have removed the Mondir in 1985. The plaintiffs' claim is that the defendant-appellant has removed the image of the idol to his house and removed the Mondir from the suit lands for grabbing the suit lands as his personal property.
